## Projects

- `ai-safari`: Multiplayer distributed AI & Systems Engineering game engine with Authoritative Host Deck, Stage 1 Solo Quests, Stage 2 Team Battles, and Cloudflare Tunnel remote controls.
- `aipcc`: This project -- the local command center, dashboard, chat, and MCP hub that the other linked projects report into.
- `aipcc-nano-forge`: Aipcc Nano Forge application linked to AIPCC.
- `bhasha-vaani`: Family language-learning platform: FastAPI backend, Vite/React PWA (primary client per ADR-004), and a legacy Flutter app still running side-by-side.
- `career-pilot`: Standalone, privacy-first, human-approved AI Career Opportunity Agent with Rust/Axum backend, SQLx, Next.js frontend, and Manifest V3 Chrome Extension.
- `fuelops`: FuelOps Petrol Bunk Management System application linked to AIPCC.
- `intervprep-ai`: Owns the real Gmail/GitHub OAuth connectors; AIPCC proxies its /api/connectors/... endpoints rather than duplicating that OAuth machinery.
- `mta`: child
- `portfolio-site`: Crisp public portfolio and 'What I'm building' live outlines: guarded static build, numbers-only pulse export, and single-use eligibility gate.
- `project-hub`: Documentation portal and sync agent that pulls docs from the other linked projects.
- `restaurant-pos`: Flutter-based restaurant point-of-sale app.
- `reya-filling-station`: Reya Filling Station application linked to AIPCC.
- `room-sense`: Room Sense application linked to AIPCC.
- `sarabhi-cinema`: Sarabhi Cinema application linked to AIPCC.
- `tishi`: Native mobile (Flutter for Android/iOS) and Samsung Wear OS (Kotlin + Compose) companion for capturing ideas, interacting with Sarabhi, receiving notifications, checking AIPCC status, and approving actions. AIPCC is the intelligence layer and system of record.
- `vistrike`: Active training/event pipeline project. Distinct from vistrike-training-videos (AI/ML workspace); this repo owns the core Vistrike application pipeline.
- `vistrike-training-videos`: Active Vistrike AI/training workspace: tennis video ML pipeline, FastAPI remote review app, agents, datasets, experiments, and Project Hub documentation manifest.
